title: Be a child honest about your mistakes
summary: This meets the ashamed heart that wants mercy without honesty. The line brings both together: love the Lord, admit the mistake, and stay under the care of Father and Mother.
lifeApplication: After the misstep, speak to God as a child, not as a defendant writing a case. Let trust tell the truth before self-protection starts performing.

source.shortMeaning: Mercy makes room for honest error and deeper childlike trust.
source.lifeApplication: After the mistake, stay in the Father's care long enough to tell the truth.

evidence.coreClaim: Mercy makes room for honest error and deeper childlike trust.
evidence.turn: Bring the truth about failure into the Lord's mercy.
